sentences.japanese: 株に手を出すなんて彼女はなんと愚かなのだろう。
sentences.english: What a fool she is to dabble in stocks!

sentences.japanese: 株でやられるまで彼は証券市場の帝王でしたよ。
sentences.english: He was a stock-market tycoon until the bears got him.

sentences.japanese: 株ですってんてんになっちまった。
sentences.english: I lost my shirt on the stock market.

sentences.japanese: 学生間では彼の株が急に上がった。
sentences.english: His stock with the students has soared.
